pro_course_detail.title: English for Work or Business
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how to have a conversation about your work or business at a meeting, a conference, a cocktail party or a business lunch. You will learn and practice how to:

teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I try my best to create a friendly, welcoming space for you to learn English. I know how nerve-wracking it can be as a language learner, no matter what level you are, and so I want you to feel happy and comfortable during our lessons to make mistakes and not feel embarrassed. Making mistakes with me is the best thing you can do as I'll correct you (nicely, of course!) and help you stop making that mistake again. All of this will be done naturally as I don't want anyone to feel overwhelmed by English, particularly when speaking with me.

Due to my style of teaching and personal preference, I do not teach children.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is relaxed but focused. I want you to feel comfortable talking to be, and I don't want you to dread lessons. I provide homework if you want it, but never feel stressed if you don't have time to do it. It's not the end of the world, and we'll have a productive lesson regardless.

Lessons with me are, I hope, like chatting with a friend who corrects you. They're based around one specific topic for each lesson. We can be talking about plastic in the environment one day, and the Game of Thrones episode the next. I will let you know the topic in advance so that you can prepare in advance. If you want it, I'll also provide preparation material.

pro_course_detail.description:

If you're looking for conversation practice then please check out my Everyday English package instead as it focuses on topical conversations based.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner's English (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you're uncertain about your level of English and you're looking for a more formal approach to learning the language to get you from beginner's (A1) to intermediate (B1) then this is the course for you.

I offer an easy, patient approach to language learning using clear spoken English with newspaper articles aimed at your level and videos that will help improve your listening and comprehension skills and get your English skills up to a conversational level so that you're comfortable moving forward with the language.

This is a course for beginner's starting out in English who have a little bit of the language but without a lot of opportunity to practice. Send me a message to find out more if you're nervous about booking a class. I'd love to talk to you!

pro_course_detail.title: Cambridge English: First (FCE), Advanced (CAE), Proficiency (CPE)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, you will follow the Cambridge English Language Assessment syllabus with the final objective of success at formal examinations in either FCE or CAE. You will practice speaking, listening, reading and writing and receive guided examination practice using authentic Cambridge materials to help you achieve the results you deserve.

You will build your confidence with the language in a friendly and professional learning environment, fully supported at every step of the learning process. This course is suitable for intermediate or advanced students seeking to achieve a certificate in the Cambridge exams; please inform the teacher of your objectives when booking a lesson, and the course will be adjusted to your level and your goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday English
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for students of all levels who want to practice speaking English in a friendly and supportive environment. Before each lesson, I will provide the topic we can discuss and, for the less-confident learners, example questions that I might ask to show you the direction the conversation might take. I will do this through the use of real-world situations and materials using native targeted videos and articles from an English speaking country, so you will be using authentic material right from the start!

You will quickly develop confidence talking about a wide range of interesting and relevant topics, and will also learn new vocabulary, phrases and idioms that you can use in everyday life.

This course is suitable for anyone who wants to practice speaking English in a more focused way so that, when you go out into the English speaking world, you can speak with confidence on a wide range of topics.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak Business English with clarity and confidence!
pro_course_detail.description:
Globalization requires that you have the right skill set to engage with the international business community. I have experience teaching Business English to professionals from multinational companies such as Microsoft, BMW, Mastercard, Gucci, TikTok, Huawei, Unilever and Shell Oil Company. 

I teach both employers and employees on how to become effective communicators in the workplace. In my classes will cover topics such as:

✔ how to develop and express your ideas clearly and confidently
 ✔ persuasive communication
✔ different types of communication styles
✔ polite communication
✔ assertiveness communication skills
✔ avoiding miscommunication
✔ business meetings (how to chair and participate in meetings)
✔ presentations (how to deliver an unforgettable presentation)
✔ negotiations (how to achieve a win-win solution)
✔ business storytelling
✔ customer service (dealing with customer complaints and queries)
✔ how to build effective business relationships
✔ writing formal emails
✔ informal vs formal language
✔ business terminology
✔ idiomatic expressions
✔ asking good business questions

I started my own company 5 years ago, so I am familiar with the language they use in business. On iTalki, I am working with professionals in the engineering, medical, digital marketing, advertising, HR,  IT, banking, and automobile industry. 

Through practical activities and customized lessons, you will be equipped with the relevant vocabulary, idioms, and functional language to effectively communicate in your unique business setting. Expect to speak confidently and clearly after these lessons. All your progress will be measurable. 

The phrasal verbs that you will learn in the lessons will set you apart in any conversation. Pronunciation will also be emphasized during these lessons. As part of their continual learning, I also send short podcasts that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational fluency for adults
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for professionals and leaders who want to improve their conversational skills and overall fluency when discussing business topics. 

The topics are based on self-development and designed to improve both your communication skills and career. Every topic is based on a business article from reputable websites such as Harvard Business Review (HBR) and Forbes. 

Some topics include: 

✔How to increase your influence in the workplace
✔How to build a personal brand at work
✔Understanding your communication style 
✔ The power of morning and evening rituals
✔ Job redesign
✔ 7Cs of communication
✔ Performance punishment
✔ Ageism in the workplace
✔ 6 thinking hats

A real conversation involves speaking, listening, asking questions and commenting on answers. To become a fluent English speaker, your brain and your mouth need to work together. I will show you how you can practically do this! All you need is some motivation, creativity, and good habits. All my conversation classes are based on real life situations. You will learn how to confidently express your ideas in a conversation.

I will help build your vocabulary and speaking confidence. You will overcome any fear you have of speaking English with another person. 

The lessons will be conducted in a relaxed environment where you will be able to acquire the relevant words and phrases necessary for effective communication. Every conversational lesson is based on an interesting topic. I will send materials to you before the class so that you become familiar with the topic. In this way, you will have more speaking practice during the lesson. See you in class! 

As part of their continual learning, I also send short podcasts that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
I have successfully prepared and helped professionals in the following types of interviews and industries: 

✔ Aviation interviews (both pilots and cabin crews) 
✔ Amazon interviews
✔ Software Engineers
✔ HR-related jobs
✔ Finance and auditing
✔ College entrance interviews
✔ Residency interviews

Success stories: I recently helped a few of my students pass their job interviews. They will now be starting new jobs with higher salaries and greater job satisfaction. (*Please check my reviews for success stories*)

Please note: It takes about 6-8 hours to prepare for a job interview depending on your English level. 

In these interactive classes, you will be introduced to all the language and strategies that you need to stand out in your interview. You will learn how to answer:

✔ "Tell me about yourself"
✔ Behavioral questions (TMAAT)
✔ Competency questions
✔ Describe your education and experience
✔ Soft skills questions
✔ General interview questions 

A successful interview requires you to tell a unique story about your skills, achievements, qualifications, and personality. I have helped many students pass their job interviews. A successful job interview is one where you are able to differentiate yourself from other candidates. 

This requires preparation, fluency, and confidence. You will be prepared to answer both common and unexpected questions in the interview. You will learn about the power words, verbs, and phrases that you need to use in your interview. You will be able to apply time-tested strategies to help effectively answer every question that is posed to you. You will learn to speak in a way that sounds "clean" and "clear". sorted_cert_info.description: A TEFL certification enables you to teach English to non-native speakers, both in your home country and abroad. With this certification, you can work as an English language teacher in schools, language institutions, online platforms, or even offer private tutoring lessons. It equips you with the necessary skills and knowledge to plan deliver effective English lessons, assess students' progress, and create a supportive learning environment  for language learners of various levels and backgrounds.

teaching_experience.description: As an assistant teacher, I supported the teacher in various aspects of classroom management and student support. This included assisting with lesson preparation, classroom organization, and providing one-on-one or small group support to students who needed extra help reading and writing in English. I also helped in supervising students during activities, maintaining a positive and safe learning environment, and occasionally leading small instructional sessions.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to your trial lesson with tutor Sam! In this session, you can expect a personalized and engaging experience focused on improving your English skills. Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your fluency, I tailor each lesson to meet your specific needs and goals. 

During our time together, we'll focus on practical conversational skills, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation. Through interactive activities, role-plays, and discussions, you'll gain confidence and fluency in using English in real-life situations. I believe in creating a supportive and encouraging environment where you can learn at your own pace and feel motivated to achieve your language goals. 

By the end of the lesson, you can expect to have improved your speaking and listening abilities, expanded your vocabulary, and gained a better understanding of English grammar. I look forward to helping you on your language learning journey and making our lessons both enjoyable and effective!

pro_course_detail.title: English Basics for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to our classroom! I am delighted to have you here learning with me. Together, we'll explore new things and have a wonderful time. 

Prepare for engaging conversations, enjoyable challenges, interesting talks, and knowledge expansion. Let's start this journey together and have a great time learning!  

In these lively and engaging lessons, students will improve their English skills by focusing on speaking, pronouncing words accurately, and using correct grammar and punctuation. The goal is to become more fluent, clear, and confident communicators. 

During these sessions, you can expect to enhance your conversational skills by participating in meaningful discussions on different topics, which will improve both your speaking and listening abilities. Additionally, you will learn how to express ideas clearly and effectively through improved English articulation, focusing on choosing the right words and structuring sentences coherently. 
Pronunciation practice will help you sound natural and easily understood while mastering essential grammar rules and punctuation will enhance your writing and speaking accuracy. 

We'll engage in interactive discussions where stimulating conversations will help you practice conversational skills and expand your vocabulary. Role-playing real-life scenarios will enhance your communication abilities. Additionally, multimedia elements such as videos, and audio clips will be incorporated to make learning lively and captivating.

By the end of these lessons, students will have the skills and confidence to speak and write in English fluently and accurately. Let's dive into this enriching journey together!

pro_course_detail.title: B1 English: Building Confidence and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to B1 English: Building Confidence and Fluency!

Are you ready to strengthen your English skills and speak with more confidence? This class is perfect for learners who want to improve their grammar, expand their vocabulary, and become more fluent in everyday conversations.

This lesson will focus on essential grammar rules to help you speak and write more accurately. You'll better understand how to construct sentences correctly and learn to avoid common mistakes, ensuring you communicate more clearly and effectively.

We will also work on expanding your vocabulary, introducing practical, everyday words and expressions that you can use in real-life situations. This will help you express yourself naturally and confidently in casual and formal settings. 
By the end of the class, you'll feel more comfortable and capable of handling conversations in English.

Let's work together to build your fluency and confidence in English!
